rules.description: Bypass API and private operational resources by default
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.example.org" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/datasets/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/healthz" "/readyz" "/metrics"}))

rules.description: Explicitly cache anonymous query-free public JSON and immutable datasets
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.example.org" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] eq "authorization") and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] eq "cookie") and (http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/games" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/games/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/stats" "/v1/datasets"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/datasets/")))
